name: Konomi Naruko
source:
"Please. Trust me."
[[i]I need to settle this matter peacefully.[/i]]

Naruko is a third year student from Class A who is the president of the student council. Her father is the principal of the school and a famous politician. She acts as a role model for everyone and has excellent grades, and is respected by students and teachers alike.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/hobe_0406/]DMM[/url] and the [url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/mojika/]official website[/url]]
